release.label: Public research preview
release.detail: iPhone smoke passed · clean creation pending
release.publicStatus: Source is public as a research preview. The compatible-graphics iPhone 16 profile scenario and the 26-step CounterLab functional smoke passed. DataMigrator success: false still blocks clean creation acceptance; Duo and iPad behavior, playback, repeatable cold startup, and app performance remain unverified.

guest.label: iPhone 16 compatible run
guest.detail: A fresh iPhone 16 guest running iOS 27.0.1, build 24A446, completed ordinary Setup Assistant through the UI without setup or migration marker edits. The controlled 12-step profile scenario passed OS, UIKit idiom, point-size, and scale checks. A separate compatible-graphics CounterLab smoke passed all 26 steps, including reset and increment, semantic scrolling and taps, Details navigation, Unicode text input, Home, and count 1 after app terminate/relaunch. The note is transient. DataMigrator success: false leaves clean creation unaccepted.

sample.label: CounterLab · SDK 27.2
sample.detail: CounterLab's warm Release build took 3.03 seconds with the Xcode 27.2 SDK. This proves the build step only and does not measure app performance.

runtime.label: Native runtime proof
runtime.detail: The compatible-graphics CounterLab smoke passed all 26 steps in one iPhone 16 run. It verified reset and increment, semantic scrolling and taps, Details navigation, Unicode text input, Home, and count 1 after app terminate/relaunch. The 52.59-second duration is scenario time, not an app performance measurement. A separate 12-step iPhone profile scenario passed its OS, idiom, point-size, and scale checks. DataMigrator success: false still blocks clean creation acceptance. Repeatable cold guest startup, playback, app performance, and Duo/iPad behavior remain unverified.

microbenchmark.title: Self-modifying code · QEMU microbenchmark
microbenchmark.description: 32 KiB code-copy workload, nine allocated vCPU caches, three interleaved runs. Rewritten instructions were validated after each run.
microbenchmark.scope: This is a QEMU cache-invalidation microbenchmark. It does not measure app startup, interaction latency, graphics performance, or user-visible speed.
